description.value: McDonald's is a globally recognised fast food chain offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, and McCafé beverages. This North Vancouver location includes a drive-through and takeaway service. It is a reliable, familiar stop for touring cyclists in need of a quick and filling meal along a busy corridor.
